_note: No prices here: the game works out each item's Retail price live from what it costs to make (plan.md 5.12; pricing in game_config.json). An item no building makes can have a fixed "price" in dollars. appetite = how many of it one villager buys per hour at the Normal price in a Supermarket (plan.md 5.16). Only finished food has one, so raw goods like Wheat can't be sold in shops. Appetites are PLACEHOLDERS, tuned so about 40 people buy what one Farm + Mill + Bakery make (not realistic amounts: the game only shows village totals).
